ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Mending Solutions
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.110
Repair damaged apparel and weapons at a hand mending station, an electrical mending station, or a fully automated industrial repair center at higher tech. Material cost, work time, waste and the risk of a botched repair all scale with how damaged the item is and how skilled the mender is. Requires Biotech. Repair work produces real waste as a core mechanic: recyclable trash with Vanilla Recycling Expanded installed, wastepacks without it. Waste can be turned off in the mod settings.
